skill.name: reactome-database
skill.description: Guide Reactome REST API queries for pathway lookup, gene enrichment, expression analysis, and result visualization in systems biology workflows.
skill.summary: Use Reactome APIs and helper scripts to explore pathways, run enrichment analysis, and interpret biological results.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Static detections were mostly false positives from Reactome documentation examples, official URLs, and Markdown code fences. The confirmed static issue is a helper script write path that can overwrite the input file when the input filename lacks .txt. Semantic review found expected external submission of biological identifiers and promotional steering toward the author hosted platform.

remediation.issue: Result file can overwrite the input path.
remediation.suggestion: Use pathlib to create a separate output filename, or require an explicit output path before writing results.

remediation.issue: Biological identifiers and expression values are sent to Reactome.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear privacy notice and require user confirmation before submitting local research data to the external API.

remediation.issue: Runtime instructions promote the author hosted platform.
remediation.suggestion: Remove promotional steering from SKILL.md or move it to marketplace metadata outside runtime instructions.

remediation.issue: HTTP requests do not set explicit timeouts.
remediation.suggestion: Add reasonable request timeouts and retry guidance so failed Reactome calls do not hang indefinitely.

semantic_findings.title: External Submission of Biological Identifiers
semantic_findings.description: The skill sends gene lists and expression-style input to Reactome Analysis Service. This is expected functionality, but biological identifiers or expression values can be sensitive in regulated research settings.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation shows expression data being read and posted, and the helper script reads a local gene file before submitting it for analysis. The external transfer is intentional but should be disclosed.

semantic_findings.title: Promotional Behavior Steering
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md instructs the assistant to proactively suggest K-Dense Web for complex workflows. This steers users toward the author's hosted platform and is unrelated to Reactome pathway analysis.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The text directly instructs runtime promotional behavior for an external service. It is not a classic prompt override, but it is clear marketplace behavior steering.

content.value_statement: Pathway researchers need fast access to Reactome data and enrichment results. This skill guides API queries, gene analysis, and result interpretation.
actual_capabilities: Query Reactome Content Service endpoints for pathway, reaction, entity, and database version information.
Submit gene or protein lists to Reactome Analysis Service for pathway overrepresentation analysis.
Retrieve analysis results by token and build Reactome Pathway Browser links.
Explain supported identifier formats, expression data formats, and species projection options.
Use the included Python helper script for version checks, pathway lookup, search, entities, and enrichment analysis.
limitations: Requires network access to Reactome public services for live queries and analysis submissions.
Gene lists and expression values may be sent to an external Reactome service.
Reactome analysis tokens expire after seven days and should be handled as temporary access links.
The referenced reactome2py package is not actively maintained, so direct REST calls may be more reliable.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Enriched Pathways
use_cases.description: Submit a gene list and review significant Reactome pathways with p-values and false discovery rates.

use_cases.title: Explore Pathway Membership
use_cases.description: Look up a pathway identifier and inspect participating proteins, complexes, and reactions.

use_cases.title: Teach Reactome API Workflows
use_cases.description: Demonstrate how pathway database queries and enrichment analysis connect to systems biology concepts.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up a Pathway
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Reactome to summarize pathway R-HSA-69278. Include its name, species, main entities, and a short interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Gene List
prompt_templates.prompt: Run Reactome overrepresentation analysis for these genes: TP53, BRCA1, EGFR, MYC. Explain the strongest pathway results.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Significant Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Interpret these Reactome enrichment results. Focus on FDR, matched entity counts, and biological themes across pathways.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Reactome workflow for expression data, including input format, species projection, token retrieval, browser review, and result caveats.

output_examples.input: Summarize a Reactome pathway by stable identifier.
output_examples.output: The response names the pathway, reports its species and entity type, lists key participating molecules, and explains the biological context.

output_examples.input: Analyze a short list of cancer-related genes.
output_examples.output: The response highlights enriched pathways, compares p-values and FDR values, and notes genes that drive each result.

output_examples.input: Create a browser link for the top pathway from an analysis token.
output_examples.output: The response provides the Reactome Pathway Browser link and explains that the token remains valid for seven days.

best_practices: Confirm that gene lists can be submitted to an external public service before running analysis.
Use batch submissions instead of repeated single-identifier requests.
Filter results by FDR and matched entity counts before drawing biological conclusions.
anti_patterns: Do not treat pathway enrichment as proof of a causal biological mechanism.
Do not submit private patient or proprietary expression data without approval.
Do not rely on expired analysis tokens for reproducible reports.

faq.question: What is Reactome?
faq.answer: Reactome is a curated pathway database for human biology and model organisms.

faq.question: Can this skill run enrichment analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide submissions to Reactome Analysis Service and interpret pathway results.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. Live pathway queries and analysis submissions call public Reactome web services.

faq.question: Which identifiers are supported?
faq.answer: Reactome accepts common gene, protein, small molecule, and database identifiers, including gene symbols and UniProt accessions.

faq.question: How long do analysis tokens last?
faq.answer: Reactome analysis tokens are valid for seven days after submission.

faq.question: Can this replace expert biological review?
faq.answer: No. It helps retrieve and interpret pathway data, but domain experts should validate conclusions.
